# Meet your new mixed reality companion

**My VR Pet** brings a lovable virtual pet into your real room, turning your everyday space into a cozy playground for care, play, and connection.

Reach out with your **bare hands** to pet, feed, carry, and care for your companion. Your cat reacts to your attention, follows your movements, wanders around your room, rests when tired, and shows its mood through playful animations, sounds, and emotes.
